# 易見 YiJian

> An iPhone app that teaches the I Ching (Yijing, Book of Changes) from zero, in Traditional Chinese and English. Eight interactive beginner lessons, then a guided reading of all 64 hexagrams with diagrams, plain-language explanations and quizzes. First three lessons free. No account; data stays on device.

易見是一套《易經》入門課程的 iPhone App：八堂課從陰陽講起，再逐卦讀完六十四卦；前三堂免費；繁體中文與英文；不需註冊，資料只存手機。

## Key facts
- Platform: iPhone (iOS 17+)
- Languages: Traditional Chinese, English
- Price: free first three lessons; membership NT$120/month or NT$990/year
- Best for: beginners who want to learn how to read I Ching hexagrams
- Not for: fortune telling or prediction; the optional casting feature is for reflection only
